svg.text: Why it improves: rub a bit out, redraw a bit
The answer is never thrown away and restarted. Each pass edits the line already on the paper.

text.tspan: Grey dashes are what was rubbed out. This is why the model can be tiny: it never has to be right in one shot, so it never needs the capacity to be.
Every pass is the same two layers doing the same job — take an imperfect line, hand back a better one.

svg.text: Illustration of the idea, not model output.
